purpose: Route unresolved Boğaziçi dining P0 unknowns to the smallest authoritative artifact, existing aggregate report, bounded owner-generated dataset or owner confirmation.

facts: A BUCard dining real-time report page existed in 2025 and packaged-meal counts were added.
Daily passage reports were updated to include packaged-meal information.
A breakfast field was added to the personnel meal report.
BUCard mobile use was deployed at dining halls and packaged-meal distribution points.
A mobile packaged-meal sales application was deployed across packaged-meal sales points.
new_public_evidence.effect_on_acquisition: Prefer existing report schema/data dictionary and source-owner aggregate exports before requesting raw BUCard events.

rules: Do not mass-contact multiple roles with the same generic request.
Ask for the smallest artifact or field definition that resolves one product gate.
Reuse existing institutional aggregate reports before proposing a new telemetry/data pipeline.
Prefer source-owner aggregation over person-level BUCard or reservation exports.
Request interval-level counts only if a named same-day action remains reachable.
A refusal, non-retention or ownership redirect is a valid research result.
Do not infer contractor settlement from user meal charges, passage reports, published diner prices or procurement totals.
Do not promote current contract-payment claims without current authoritative contract/specification evidence or current-owner confirmation tied to that artifact.
Formal information-acquisition channels are a narrow public-document fallback, not a bypass around legitimate access restrictions.

queue.title: Current production quantity owner, freeze time and same-day adjustability

minimum_request.artifact_or_example: One recent normal meal-service workflow or redacted planning/request record

interview_extension: Who currently looks at the BUCard dining real-time report?
Can quantity, reserve, second batch, package/hall channel or campus allocation change after live counts begin arriving?
acceptable_evidence: Owner-confirmed workflow tied to a current named artifact
Redacted planning/request record plus field definitions
queue.downstream_gate: Reachable pre-service or intra-service decision/control-point gate
queue.stop_condition: If quantity, allocation, service mode, reserve release and batch cannot be changed before or during usable signals, stop forecast/live-control work and test another control surface.

queue.title: Current accepted-service and hakediş quantity semantics

minimum_request.artifact_or_example: The smallest current clause/template/data dictionary identifying accepted quantity and hakediş basis

acceptable_evidence: Blank/redacted hakediş summary template with quantity definition
Current owner confirmation tied to the authoritative artifact
queue.stop_condition: No TRY-savings, per-meal economic value or contractor-P&L claim until current semantics and relevant unit-price/variable-cost meaning are verified.

queue.title: Existing BUCard dining-report schema/export and reservation-to-realized-service reconciliation

first_minimum_request.artifact_or_example: Current BUCard dining real-time/daily-passage report schema, data dictionary or blank/redacted template
questions: What physical/business event does each count represent?
Which dimensions exist: date, campus/location, meal period, service channel, actor class?
Is the real-time report historically retained or current-state only?
Can a bounded aggregate export be generated?
How are package sales, hall passages, QR events, corrections, refunds and offline transactions represented?
Which institutional roles currently consume the reports?

second_request_if_semantics_support_pilo.artifact_or_example: Source-owner aggregate service rows for a bounded reservation/service period

acceptable_evidence: Owner-generated aggregate export with event definitions
Aggregate manually reconciled table validated by owner
queue.downstream_gate: Aggregate data feasibility + reservation residual-uncertainty + possible same-day pacing gate
queue.stop_condition: If existing aggregate reports are sufficient, do not request raw events. If reservation/report counts already meet accepted operational tolerance and no reachable action remains, do not build residual ML or real-time control for its own sake.

queue.title: Physical surplus and waste-stage measurement boundary

minimum_request.artifact_or_example: Current data dictionary or one prospective measurement sheet

acceptable_evidence: Prospective one-service measurement protocol accepted by operator
queue.stop_condition: If pre-consumer surplus cannot be distinguished at the decision boundary, claim only demand/service optimization until prospective waste measurement exists.

queue.title: Directive-required produced/consumed/discarded monthly report schema

minimum_request.artifact_or_example: Blank/redacted monthly food-flow report template or metric data dictionary

acceptable_evidence: Owner-confirmed workflow tied to named systems
queue.stop_condition: If the process is already automated and decision-useful, do not duplicate it; if manual but low-pain, do not mistake reporting work for a market.

queue.title: Current contract/specification authoritative version locator

minimum_request.artifact_or_example: Authoritative current document/version identifiers and the narrow quantity/acceptance/payment clauses for İKN 2025/1727143

acceptable_evidence: Official locator/access direction from owner unit
queue.stop_condition: Stop derivative web search once owner confirms the current authoritative document is non-public or requires formal request.

required_evidence: live report latency and counting semantics
kill_if: all relevant production/dispatch is irreversible before live counts arrive
no operator can act on the report
aggregate counts cannot be reconciled to remaining demand

sequence_note: EA-03 is moved earlier because existing BUCard aggregate reports may cheaply determine whether both pre-service reservation reconciliation and intra-service pacing are feasible before economic modeling.

evidence_promotion.PUBLIC_SOURCE: Inspected current/public artifact supports the narrow claim.
evidence_promotion.INTERVIEW: Completed interview artifact supports only the role-appropriate narrow claim.
evidence_promotion.CURRENT_CONTRACT_EVIDENCE: Current authoritative contract/specification or current-owner confirmation tied to it.
evidence_promotion.TECH_TEST: Actual run output with method version, dataset provenance, evaluation period and limitations.
evidence_promotion.MODEL_RESULT: Model output only; never measured impact by default.
